name: Vampire
description: Undead creature of the night, sustained by blood.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Regain HP when you deal damage to a living creature.

abilities.name: Sunlight Weakness
abilities.description: Take extra damage when exposed to direct sunlight.

name: Werewolf
description: Cursed shapeshifter bound to the moon.

abilities.name: Beast Form
abilities.description: Transform under the full moon into a powerful wolf form.

abilities.name: Pack Instinct
abilities.description: Gain advantage on tracking and intimidation.

name: Lich
description: An undead spellcaster who cheated death through dark magic.

abilities.name: Phylactery
abilities.description: Your soul is bound to an object; you cannot truly die while it exists.

abilities.name: Necrotic Touch
abilities.description: Your unarmed strikes deal necrotic damage.

name: Changeling
description: A being who can alter their appearance at will.

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.description: Assume the appearance of any humanoid you have seen.

abilities.name: Uncanny Valley
abilities.description: Close inspection may reveal your true nature.
